scenarios.name: wire-payload-accounting

checks.name: payload-contract-present
checks.detail: user payload carries the role/response-schema contract

checks.name: manifest-entries-present
checks.detail: compact manifest entries reach the user payload

checks.name: privacy-sentinels-scrubbed
checks.detail: private reasoning / finding prose never reach the wire

notes: analyst user payload = 23,883 bytes, of which the inline response-schema contract = 5,480 bytes. A tool-call-mode dedup saving must come out of the duplicate only, never the degraded-mode copy (scenario 2).

scenarios.name: degraded-transport-contract

checks.name: inline-schema-parses
checks.detail: the in-message schema is valid JSON object form

checks.name: inline-schema-carries-full-contract
checks.detail: inline schema top-level required/properties match the real model schema

checks.name: inline-schema-keeps-nested-definitions
checks.detail: nested $defs survive (degraded modes lose the tools[] copy entirely)

notes: Schema dedup MUST be mode-conditional: when the adapter falls back to json-object/plain, this in-message contract is the only schema the model sees. Removing it unconditionally would remove the contract exactly when tool enforcement is weakest.

scenarios.name: reviewer-retry-parity

checks.name: retry-budget-is-bounded
checks.detail: MAX_INVALID_STRUCTURED_ROLE_RETRIES=1

checks.name: exhausted-retries-reject-not-unavailable
checks.detail: status=rejected

checks.name: limitation-mentions-invalid-output
checks.detail: limitations record the invalid structured output

checks.name: context-preserved-across-retries
checks.detail: 2 reviewer calls, each still carrying the full manifest/finding context (no context stripping mid-retry)

notes: BLIND-RETRY baseline: every retry re-sent an identical prompt. Retry feedback will change this; the recovery semantics above must not change (retries <= 2, REJECTED status).

scenarios.name: quota-fail-fast

checks.name: quota-429-marks-attempt-unavailable
checks.detail: status=UNAVAILABLE

checks.name: single-provider-call-no-pipeline-burn
checks.detail: analyst invoked 1x before the attempt ended

notes: A preflight probe must preserve this: any preflight extra call is a budgeted addition, and quota-exhausted runs must never proceed into the full role pipeline (observed cost: ~243 min / 1.45M prompt tokens across 8 doomed attempts).

scenarios.name: adjudicator-determinism

checks.name: replaced-core-claim-rejected
checks.detail: status=REJECTED, published findings=0

checks.name: rejection-is-publication-validation
checks.detail: limitations name publication validation

notes: Publication invariants are code-enforced. Any prompt/schema slimming must leave this behavior byte-identical: a model can never publish a finding the reviewers did not establish, whatever the payload shape.

scenarios.name: corpus-coverage-parity

checks.name: evidence-handles-traceable
checks.detail: compact manifest entries + handle format keep evidence requestable

checks.name: run-id-traceable
checks.detail: source run id reaches the model payload

checks.name: expectation-entry-traceable
checks.detail: expectation entries (reference paths, alternatives) reach the payload

checks.name: prompt-guardrails-intact
checks.detail: analyst prompt guardrails survive prompt slimming

notes: Manifest compaction may only remove redundancy (duplicate fields, repeated boilerplate); every evidence id, run id, and expectation entry must remain reachable, and prompt guardrails must stay.

scenarios.name: redesign-round-trip

checks.name: proposer-role-and-payload
checks.detail: proposer receives page payload + audience

checks.name: proposer-schema-in-payload
checks.detail: proposer contract rides in the user payload

checks.name: critic-gets-consolidated-proposals-and-digests
checks.detail: critic receives every consolidated proposal + page digests

checks.name: proposal-invariants-survive-critic
checks.detail: critic re-emit keeps ids, page refs, principles, and section refs

notes: critic payload = 3,637 bytes and the critic re-emits every accepted proposal verbatim (observed cost: 11.8k completion tokens, 797s with 2 retries). Compaction may shrink duplicated context but must keep the invariants above.

scenarios.name: cognitive-payload-coverage

checks.name: decision-returns-structured-action
checks.detail: cognitive agent returned a structured inspect decision

checks.name: goal-and-visible-elements-present
checks.detail: goal + newly-revealed/remembered elements reach the payload

checks.name: available-controls-reference-visible-elements
checks.detail: available_controls is an id list referencing elements in the payload (stage-3 dedup: no duplicated full objects)

checks.name: element-ids-unique-across-lists
checks.detail: element ids stay distinct across newly-revealed and remembered lists

checks.name: no-private-execution-leak
checks.detail: private execution refs, hidden labels, selectors, and destinations never reach the model

notes: Cognitive payload slimming (stage 3 landed: available_controls is an id list) must keep element ids stable per step and never leak private execution data. Structured-output retry for this role lives in the adapter/application layer, not the provider (scenario 3 covers retry semantics for report roles).
